versions.content: On reception of a TLS “close_notify” message the TLS connection shall be closed and all security related resources shall be destroyed. It shall not be possible to perform further plain text communication through TCP on this socket after the TLS connection was closed. Thus, it is recommended to close the TCP socket, too.
